findings.current: Someone’s hand, horribly bent and broken moments ago but slowly healing, clamped down on the horn along with him.
findings.defect: The draft makes the injured hand grasp the horn; the Skeleton King catches that hand along with the horn.
findings.rationale: 손아귀가 뿔과 함께 붙잡힌다 makes the hand something seized, not the actor seizing the horn.
findings.replacement: He caught the hand gripping the horn as well—a hand that had been horribly bent and broken earlier but was slowly healing.
findings.source: 이미 앞서 처참히 꺾이고 부서졌음에도, 서서히 회복해 나가던 누군가의 손아귀가 뿔과 함께 붙잡힌다.

findings.current: We took more casualties than expected because of a man named Huginn, but we teamed up with the Peace and Ares Guilds and subdued them.
findings.defect: The plural object changes who was subdued: the report identifies Huginn as the difficult opponent.
findings.rationale: 후긴이라는 자 is the subject of the casualty explanation and the understood object of 제압한 뒤; his capture also matters to the ensuing interrogation.
findings.replacement: We took more casualties than expected because of a man named Huginn, but we joined forces with the Peace and Ares Guilds and subdued him.
findings.source: 후긴이라는 자 때문에 생각했던 것 이상으로 피해가 컸지만…… 평화 및 아레스 길드와 힘을 합쳐 제압한 뒤

findings.current: the World Hunter Federation strips you of every right you possess
findings.defect: Revoking qualifications or standing becomes deprivation of every personal right.
findings.rationale: 모든 자격 refers to qualifications or eligibility, not all rights.
findings.replacement: the World Hunter Federation revokes all your qualifications
findings.source: 세계 헌터 연맹은 네게 주어진 모든 자격을 박탈하고

findings.current: Was the anger in his eyes, wide in those final moments, or was it the death he could no longer stop?
findings.defect: The draft presupposes anger and obscures what the narrator is questioning.
findings.rationale: The source asks why his eyes widened—anger or approaching death—without settling on either.
findings.replacement: Did his eyes widen in anger at the last moment? Or because he could no longer stave off death?
findings.source: 마지막 순간 부릅뜬 눈동자는 분노 때문일까. 아니면 더는 막을 수 없는 죽음 때문일까.

findings.current: “Isn’t that right, Jin Taekyung? You treacherous human.”
findings.defect: “Treacherous” suggests betrayal where the familiar insult is about Jin’s deviousness.
findings.rationale: 간악한 does not accuse Jin of betraying the speaker.
findings.replacement: “Isn’t that right, Jin Taekyung? You conniving human.”
findings.source: 그렇지 않으냐, 진태경. 이 간악한 인간아.

findings.defect: The standalone narration uses the rendering assigned to 골골 rather than the packet’s binding rendering for 골골이.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary distinguishes 골골이 as Bones from 골골 as Golgoli.

findings.current: a young man who hadn’t even lost his baby fat
findings.defect: Baby fat substitutes a different physical impression for youthful facial down.
findings.rationale: 솜털 refers to fine hair, not facial fullness.
findings.replacement: a young man who still had peach fuzz on his face

summary: Several action and subject errors need correction, along with a legal-status change and localized terminology and wording issues.
